transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Live and bootstrap notifications upsert root context from last.totalTokens and modelContextWindow. percentageSource is the literal derived. usedPercentage is not set.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: modelContextWindow null retracts root context. Child occupancy is not upserted.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: The rollout tail reads the same two counts from the last token_count record and does not set a percentage. contextBootstrapBatch would copy usedPercentage if the event had one. The only caller does not set it, so that branch is unreachable from the wired producer.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: Usage samples are separate and are not emitted for bootstrap phase.
